description: ONE tiny square keyboard keycap displaying ONLY the uppercase letter E clearly centered. E must have one vertical stroke and three horizontal strokes, a simple readable 3x5 pixel uppercase E. Dark navy face, light gray metallic keycap border, tiny cyan tech accent. Clean 16-bit GBA sci-fi UI matching Mars Crafts, crisp square pixels and simple palette. Keycap occupies at most 12x11 pixels, centered within a transparent 16x16 canvas with at least 2px empty margin on all sides to allow gentle bobbing. No extra letters, no keyboard, no panel, no scenery, no shadow outside the key.

style_image.usage_description: Existing Mars Crafts art reference: preserve palette, clean pixel detail, outline, lighting and object identity as described. Do not reproduce reference subject if requesting a different prop.
